posts.title: Test Flake: Chrome Clicks
posts.description: This is the first in what I expect to be an ongoing series of posts on common sources of test flake. Today: Chrome! Specifically, sometimes clicking a link in end-to-end tests, even on a static page, doesn’t navigate to the next page.
